I know what it means to grow up with limited opportunity.

That’s why I’m focused on expanding access so everyday Americans can build a better future for themselves and their families.


U.S. Senate Banking Committee GOP (@BankingGOP)

📺 Chairman @SenatorTimScott: “It should not take wealth to build wealth.”

At the Institute for Portfolio Alternatives’ 2026 Summit, Chairman Scott highlighted his efforts to expand access to capital, support innovation, and tackle affordability so hardworking fam
Thanks to the Captain and Joint Base Charleston team for an amazing afternoon!

Americans deserve leadership that puts the safety and security of our nation first - not political games.

Video

Small businesses and entrepreneurs represent the spirit of the American Dream.

Across South Carolina and the nation, it's people like Cat Dority who keep our communities thriving!

Video

The Working Families Tax Cuts make Opportunity Zones permanent so we can continue to drive new investment into the communities that need it most.

In fact, @SCcommerce is currently accepting nominations for new OZs, ensuring local voices have a say in their future! For more details: sccommerce.com/opportunity-z…

Through his blacksmith apprenticeship with Julian D. Williams Blacksmith & Co., Moses is able to see every step of the process and build real experience in the field. Apprenticeships allow you to find something you're passionate about and jumpstart your career!

Video

I introduced the Clinical Trial Modernization Act to remove barriers to participation and expand access to clinical trials, especially for rural and underserved communities.

Better access means better data—and better outcomes for patients across the country. scott.senate.gov/media-cente…

It was my honor to introduce my friend, Catherine Dority, to the Senate Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

As VP of Marketing for @ExploreCHS, Cat represents the hardworking individuals who power Charleston’s small businesses and uphold our rich history!

Video

After 76 days of Democrat obstruction, funding for DHS has finally been sent to President Trump’s desk for his signature. Thank you to Secret Service, TSA, Coast Guard, FEMA, and CISA personnel for your service while Democrats played politics with your livelihoods and America’s national security.

ICE and CBP next!

Wonderful to hear from the @SusanGKomen SC Advocates and their efforts to assist women with breast cancer treatment access, preventative research, and overall care.

Thank you for all you do to support women’s health across South Carolina!

Apprenticeships transition you from a student to a professional through hands-on experience. Ryan, who is completing his machinist apprenticeship with JMMS Inc., is grateful to work with experienced professionals to set his future up for success! #NationalApprenticeshipWeek

Video

It was an honor to escort Their Majesties King Charles III and Queen Camilla ahead of the King’s address to Congress. 
This marked a historic state visit that reaffirms the strength of our nations’ special relationship.

Julian’s favorite part of being an apprentice with Julian D. Williams Blacksmith & Co. is the ability to improve on his skills in the shop, which is a quality he was always motivated by while playing sports. Julian recommends apprenticeships to anyone who wants to learn and grow in their given field! #NationalApprenticeshipWeek

Video

Thank you to the dedicated healthcare workers across the state, as well as the @CDCgov and @HHSGov, for their coordinated efforts to bring the measles outbreak in South Carolina to an end.

I also appreciate @SecKennedy's support for my PREDICT Act, which strengthens wastewater surveillance to detect outbreaks – including measles - earlier and proactively protect our communities.

Video

Lauren is working as a nursing support apprentice with Prisma Health. Her grandpa’s experiences with the nurses who cared for him inspired her to do the same and give back to her community. We can’t wait to see all the lives you positively impact, Lauren! #NationalApprenticeshipWeek

Video

During National Apprenticeship Week, we celebrate the power of apprenticeships in providing both classroom learning and hands-on experience that help individuals grow in their chosen field.

Apprentices have the unique opportunity to be students while earning pay at the same time, gaining real-world skills with an income.

These programs open doors to meaningful careers while strengthening the future workforce!

It’s never too early or too late to learn how to put your money to work.

To South Carolinians across all 46 counties, you can start building a stronger future for you and your family today. #FinancialLiteracyMonth

Last night was a sobering reminder of why DHS funding must be passed now! Our Secret Service agents are risking their lives to protect others.

Democrats need to stop playing games with Americans’ safety and livelihoods, and do their jobs!


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

Reminder: Secret Service has been unfunded for more than 70 days now.



— https://nitter.net/BillMelugin_/status/2048210634957856910#m

I’m grateful that President Trump and all those who attended the White House Correspondents’ Dinner are safe, and for our courageous law enforcement officers who acted swiftly to protect lives.

As more information becomes available, let’s remain prayerful and give thanks for those who keep us safe.
